Hindustan Copper HCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 43 Posts - Complete Details

Hindustan Copper (HCL) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for 43 Executive posts. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications from 21 September 2026 to 5 october 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, hindustancopper.com.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 16 September 2026
  • Notification Date : 16 September 2026
  • Online Application Last Date : 5 October 2026, till 11:00 PM
  • Date of Reckoning for Eligibility (age, qualification, experience) : 1 September 2026

Application Fee

  • Disciplines/Cadres : Industrial Safety, Geology, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Medical & Health Services (M&HS), Environment Management, Mineral Processing, Finance, Human Resources, Survey
  • Total Posts : 43
  • Online Application Start : 21 September 2026, 11:00 AM onwards
  • Online Application Last Date : 5 October 2026, till 11:00 PM
  • Discipline / Cadre : Total
  • Industrial Safety : 3
  • Discipline : Essential Qualification
  • Industrial Safety : Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Technology with PG Degree/Diploma in Safety Engineering Mgt., or B.Tech in Safety/Fire Engineering
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) : 3 years
  • SC : 5 years
  • PWD – General : 10 years
  • PWD – OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) : 13 years
  • PWD – SC : 15 years

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
